title: FP8 is All You Need (Part 2): Efficient Ozaki-Bailey Style FFT Through Tensor-core Garner Reformulation and Kulisch Escape Route
summary:
arXiv:2606.23698v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: NVIDIA's Blackwell Ultra (B300) cuts FP64 vector throughput to ~1.3 TFLOPS per GPU, roughly 30x below B200 and well below the level at which bandwidth-limited FP64 workloads stay memory-bound. The Ozaki Scheme II framework recovers FP64-equivalent throughput by routing dense matrix multiply through FP8 tensor cores with a mantissa-sliced Chinese-remainder reconstruction. title: VeriPilot: An LLM-Powered Verilog Debugging Framework
summary:
arXiv:2606.23759v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Verilog debugging remains one of the most time-consuming stages in digital circuit design.
